summary: Aureus Greenway Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K announcing that its Form S-4 registration statement for the proposed business combination with Autonomous Power Corporation (Powerus) was declared effective by the SEC on August 12, 2026. The joint press release cites risks including regulatory approvals (HSR, Nasdaq listing) and shareholder approval, and potential termination of the merger agreement. No financial terms, prices, premiums, or advisor names are disclosed. This is a procedural milestone in a merger, not a standalone special-situation category, so 'Other' applies. Watch for shareholder vote timing and closing conditions.
